bare.comment: Ignore waits; warm iff a D-U pair is not preceded by UU and not followed by DD.

random answers.comment: Track dial position p (starts 0) and warm flag (starts true): wait does nothing; turn up turns cold if warm and p>=1, turns warm if cold and p<0, then p++; turn down turns cold if warm and p<=0, then p--.

rivals choose.comment: Hidden state: dial position (0-2) and temperature integer. Turning changes dial and adjusts temp by a value depending on current dial; waiting adjusts temp based on dial. Room warm if temp >= 0.

rivals.comment: Explanation: hidden counters of up/down/wait plus first and last actions; warm when there is at least one down, one or two ups, and two exceptional cases do not happen.
Explanation: hidden first/last action and counts of up/down; warm depends mainly on the last action and a small count pattern.
Explanation: hidden length, counts of up/down, and first/last actions; warm if a 3-step run has both up and down, or a 4-step run matches one of three count/end patterns.
Explanation: hidden opening pattern only; warm if the first two actions are down-up and the third is up, or if the first two are up-down, down-down, or wait-down.
Explanation: Waits do nothing; the heater remembers the exact sequence of turn up/down, and only DU, DUU, DUUD, DDDU, UDU are warm.
Explanation: Waits are inert for short runs; the heater tracks the first two turns and down-count, warming only in a few starting patterns.
Explanation: Waits are inert at first but later act like up-turns; the heater counts direction changes and warms on one down-to-up change with few turns, or no up-to-down change and ending up.

Explanation: Waits are inert for short runs; later waits become down-turns when the down-count is even, otherwise up-turns. The heater warms on an odd number of downs ending with up, if few ups, or on the exact history DUUD.
